checks.name: covered-scope
checks.detail: Removal of non-owned flood-borne debris (stones) from underneath the insured building to the perimeter of the building in the yard

checks.name: excluded-scope
checks.detail: Transportation, handling, disposal, and yard-work components outside the perimeter footprint; barge transportation costs

checks.name: price-support
checks.detail: Additional evidence that the estimated dollar amount from the contractor is limited to the covered scope of work; other debris removal estimates from one or more different contractors to validate the $3,564 per cubic yard price with sales tax

checks.name: prior-claim-overlap
checks.detail: Review documentation for previous claims filed on May 20, 2019, May 29, 2019, and June 11, 2019 to verify if debris removal for the same area underneath the building was performed before the July 2019 flood event
